description_en: Situated immediately to the east of the Narvadeśvara Devala, Janārdane Pāṭī occupies a modest yet significant position within the ritual landscape of the site. Although architecturally it is a two-storeyedsataḥ, local usage does not identify it as asattalorcapāḥ. Instead, it is commonly known as Janārdane Pāṭī, reflecting its association with its donor's name: Janārdana. The ground floor consists of a three-bayed Phalcā. The western bay, oriented toward the Narvadeśvara shrine, is left open as an uncoveredkavala. The structure is built with locally available materials such as stone, earth, and timber, and displays no deliberate ornamental or decorative treatment. Access to the upper storey is typically provided through a rectangular opening in the centre of the floor slab, just wide enough for a person to pass through. The walls are finished with a traditional plaster made of cow dung, clay, chaff, and cotton fibres, over which a whitewash has been applied.No dedicatory inscription relating to the construction of this Sataḥ has survived. However, the persistent oral tradition referring to it as Janārdane Pāṭī indicates that it was commissioned by Janārdana Sāpakoṭā. In 1914 CE (VS 1971), Janārdana, also known as Pṛthvīvilāsa, constructed both a Śivālaya and this Sataḥ at his family’skuladevatāsthāna. This initiative expanded the site’s function beyond lineage-based worship to include regular religious activities centred on the Śiva shrine. The construction of Janārdane Pāṭī appears to have been intended to facilitate these emerging religious and cultural practices. These details are remembered by Rāmajī Sāpakoṭā (aged 76 in 2025), Janārdana’s grandson, who belongs to the late Rāṇā-period generation (oral testimony). On this basis, the Janārdane Pāṭī can be securely dated to a period after 1914 CE (VS 1971).During the 1980s CE (VS 2040s), the originaljhĩgaṭīroofing was removed and replaced with corrugated metal sheets. Even prior to the 2015 earthquakes, the structure had already fallen into a dilapidated condition. Although the earthquake did not cause its collapse, local informants report (2025 CE) that the Sataḥ exhibits multiple structural cracks and widespread detachment of the plaster surface (oral testimony R. Sāpakoṭā).Historically, the Phalcā on the ground floor served as a functional space during major ritual occasions such as Śivarātrī, Rāmanavamī, Kṛṣṇāṣṭamī, Rudrī rituals, and Purāṇapāṭha. On the full-moon day of Jyeṣṭha, a large-scalekulapūjāof the Sāpakoṭā lineage is performed at the familykuladevatāsthānalocated here. This ritual includes animal sacrifice and is followed by a communal feast. All food prepared for this occasion is traditionally cooked in the Phalcā, underscoring its continuing role as an integral space for collective ritual and social activities associated with the lineage (oral testimony R. Sāpakoṭā).
description_ne: विसं १९७१ (सन् १९१४) मा शिवालय र सतः बनेको स्थानमा जनार्दन सापकोटा नामका व्यक्तिले यो सतः थपेका हुन् ।नरवदेश्वर देवलकोसँगै पूर्वतिर यो सतः अवस्थित छ । आकार र स्वरूपले दुईतले सतः भए तापनि बोलीचालीमा स्थानीयले यसलाई सत्तल वा चपाः नभनी ‘जनार्दने पाटी’ भन्ने गरेका छन् । सतःको भूमि तलामा तीन कवलको फल्चा छ । फल्चाको पश्चिमी खण्ड अर्थात् नरवदेश्वर देवालयतिरको खण्ड खुला कवलका रूपमा छाडिएको छ । सतः ढुङ्गा, माटो, काँठ जस्ता गाउँमै उपलब्ध सामग्रीको प्रयोगबाट बनेको छ । यसमा विशेष बुट्टा एवं सौन्दर्यकरणको प्रयोग भएको छैन । सतःको माथिल्लो तलामा जान दलिन माझ मान्छे अट्ने आयताकार खाली ठाउँ छाडिएको छ । सतःका भित्तामा गोबर, माटो, भुस, कपास आदिको मिश्रणबाट गरिने परम्परागत लेप (प्लाष्टर) को प्रयोग छ । उक्त लेपमाथि सेतो रङ्ग पोतिएको छ ।यस सतःको निर्माणबारे लेखिएको अभिलेख छैन । तर स्थानीयमा यस पाटीलाई ‘जनार्दने पाटी’ भन्ने मौखिक परम्पराका आधारमा यसका निर्माता जनार्दन सापकोटा भएको खुल्दछ । पृथ्वीविलासले विसं १९७१ (सन् १९१४) मा आफ्नो कुलदेवताथानमा सतः र शिवालय बनाएका थिए । यसबाट कुलपूजामात्र नभई यो स्थानमा शिवालयमा पनि धार्मिक गतिविधि हुन थालेको थियो । यहाँ हुने यस्ता धार्मिक-सांस्कृतिक कार्यमा सुविधा होस् भन्ने उद्देश्यले उनले यो सतः थपेका थिए । जनार्दनकै नाति रामजि सापकोटा आफ्ना बाजे र यो सतः निर्माणबारे जानकारी राख्छन् र यी तथ्य सुनाउछन् । उनी पृथ्वीविलासकै समकालीन अर्थात् राणाकालको उत्तरार्धतिरका पात्र थिए (one of the descendant of the initial constructor, male, age 76) । यसबाट यो सतः विसं १९७१ (सन् १९१४) पछि बनेको थाहा हुन्छ । विसं २०४० को दशकमा सतःमाथिको झिंगटी हटाई जस्तापाता छाइएको थियो । सतः पछिल्लो महाभूकम्प अगावै जीर्ण अवस्थामा थियो । जीर्ण सतः भूकम्पले नढलेको तर हाल (सन् २०२५) ठाउँ-ठाउँमा चिरा परी प्लाष्टर उप्कदै गएको कुरा स्थानीय सुनाउछन् (one of the descendant of the initial constructor, male, age 76) ।यस सतःको भूमि तलामा भएको फल्चा विगत शिवरात्री, रामनवमी, कृष्णाष्टमी, रुद्री, पुराणपाठ जस्ता कार्य हुँदा प्रयोगमा आउने गर्दथ्यो । जेष्ठ शुक्ल पूर्णिमाका दिन यस स्थानमा भएको सापकोटा खलकको कुलदेवताथानमा ठुलो स्तरमा कुलपूजा हुने गरेको छ । बलि सहित हुने पूजा पश्चात् यहाँ सो खलकले भोज खाने चलन छ । भोजका खातिर पकाइनुपर्ने सबै परिकार यस सतःफल्चाभित्र पकाउने गरिएको छ (one of the descendant of the initial constructor, male, age 76) ।

historical_events.event_description: Rāmajī Sāpakoṭā, the grandson of Janārdana, details that his grandfather Janārdana belonged to the same generation as Pṛthvīvilāsa, that is, to the late Rāṇā-period generation (oral testimony at age of 76, in 2025).जनार्दनकै नाति रामजि सापकोटा आफ्ना बाजेबारे जानकारी राख्छन् र यी तथ्य सुनाउछन् । जनार्दन पृथ्वीविलासकै समकालीन अर्थात् राणाकालको उत्तरार्धतिरका पुस्ता थिए (one of the descendants of the initial constructor, male, age 76) ।
